_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Kei te takaro koe i te Kāri (Kēmu) - Player {player_id}.
Whāinga: Whakaputaina te toa iti rawa i tēnei raupapa kotahi. Ki te whakaritea ngā kohatu, ka whakauruhia hei 0.
Ngā uara kāri: A=1, 2-10=whakaahua, J/Q=10, K=0

Ngā mahi (whakamahia ngā whakawhāiti tika):
- '[draw]' - Tangohia mai i te tāhuhu
- '[take]' - Tangohia mai i te puranga whakarere
- '[swap X Y]' - Whakawhiti te kāri i tangohia ki te tūranga X (rori) Y (kohatu)
- '[discard]' - Whakarere i te kāri i tangohia

board.drew:
I tangohia e koe: {card}
Inaianei me [swap X Y] ranei [discard]
board.took: I tangohia e koe: {card} mai i te puranga makawe Me [swap X Y] me ia (kaore e taea te whakakore).
board.peeked: I tirotirohia e koe ki te tūranga ({row},{col}): {card}

options.final_turns: Ngā whakatau whakamutunga! Ko ngā kōwhiringa: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Me: [swap X Y] (kaore e taea te whakakore i nga kaari mai i te puranga o te maka)

action_desc.swapped: Player {pid} kua whakawhiti {new} ki {old} ki te tūranga ({row},{col})

message.deck_empty: Kua kore te papa! Ka mutu tonu te kēmu.
message.knocked: Ka patua te kaitākaro {pid}! E kotahi anō ngā huringa a ia kaitākaro.
message.final_round: Player {pid} {reason}! Each other player gets one more turn.

invalid.wrong_action: Whakamahia kotahi anake o ngā mahi whakawhāiti: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], ranei [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: Kua kore te puranga o ngā mea kua maka!
invalid.must_draw_first: Me tirotiro koe tuatahi [draw], [take], [knock], ranei [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Kāore e taea te whakakore i tētahi kāri kua tangohia mai i ngā tūru whakakahoretanga. Me whakawhiti kētia.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Kei a koe he kāri whakatahia. Me [swap X Y] ranei [discard]
invalid.need_drawn_swap: E hiahia ana koe ki tētahi kāri kua tāpaetia hei whakawhiti.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: E hiahia ana koe ki tētahi kāri kua tāpaetia hei whakakore.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Tūranga ki waho. Whakamahia rori 1-{max_row}, kohatu 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Kāore e taea te patu me tētahi kāri kua oti kē. Whakamahia tō rerenga tuatahi.
invalid.already_knocked: Kua oti kē i tētahi te patu tēnei rauna.
